layout_and_spacing.general: Generous spacing philosophy, generous internal padding in bordered containers.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Base grid md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Every pixel utilized.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl for major cards, rounded-xl for inner elements, rounded-full for badges.

components.cards: Flat background (surface), 1px solid subtle border (border color), NO default shadow. On hover: shadow-lg, -translate-y-1.
components.buttons: Primary button uses Terracotta. Hover must increase color depth and explicitly set text color to white. Use rounded-full or rounded-xl.
components.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky headers. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px bottom border border-border/40, backdrop-saturate-150.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI forms customized to remove standard 'Vercel' look. Use rounded-xl, subtle border, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent.
components.badges: For time slots/statuses. Soft background (10% opacity of color) with bold text of the same hue.

motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets and menu grids.
motion.images: Image hover effect: scale-105 transition-transform duration-500.

icons.style: Use uniform stroke width (1.5px or 2px). Ensure icons in buttons are visually balanced with text padding.

hero_background.description: Abstract organic background for dashboard loading states or side panels

login_hero.description: Appetizing wide-angle university canteen image for login/onboarding screen

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the color palette and typography. Do not use Inter or generic blue/gray scales.
Implement the bento grid (Mode B) for the Staff and Admin dashboards with tight gaps (gap-6) and utilized pixels.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for creative layout wrappers, but use heavily customized Shadcn UI for forms, dialogs, and select menus.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, tabs).
Ensure contrast passes APCA standards; text on primary buttons must be #FFFFFF.
Do not use card components everywhere; vary the container shapes. Example: use cardless rows for simple list items.
For the food menu, use a Masonry or Tetris-like grid to break monotony.
Use the provided image URLs for placeholders, do not use dummyimage or via.placeholder.com.
Since files are .js/.jsx, write Javascript for React components and strictly avoid .tsx types.
